result.source: JPML website (Judicial Panel on Multidistrict Litigation)
result.description: The JPML website serves as an administrative hub for federal multidistrict litigation. While it provides detailed statistics and docket lists related to product liability cases (including medical devices like Philips CPAP machines, Bair Hugger warming devices, and port catheters), it does not report hospital-level adverse event data. The reports focus on the management of litigation dockets rather than patient-level or facility-level incident reporting. Furthermore, the data is exclusively provided in PDF format, which lacks the structure required for a direct automated ingest pipeline.
result.verdict: This site provides administrative litigation statistics and docket headings in PDF format but lacks hospital-level adverse event data or machine-readable datasets for an automated ingest pipeline.
